name: Taming the Beast

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn the patience and respect needed to bond with fierce wild predators.

faq.answer: Taming the Beast is a hunter's training trial, where you use an enchanted Taming Rod to tame a Gray Forest Wolf.
faq.q: What is the quest Taming the Beast?

aliases: where to turn in taming the beast
faq.answer: Josephine Carson instructs you and gives you the Taming Rod. After the trial, you return it to her.
faq.q: Who gives and completes this quest?

faq.answer: You are instructed to tame a Gray Forest Wolf, a fiercer forest predator than the boars you handled before.
faq.q: What creature do you have to tame?

faq.answer: Josephine Carson gives you the Taming Rod to soothe a wild Gray Forest Wolf and form a temporary bond without causing permanent harm.
faq.q: What is the Taming Rod used for?

faq.answer: Before facing the Gray Forest Wolf, you practiced handling a forest boar.
faq.q: What did the hunter tame before this trial?

faq.answer: No. After practicing your beast-bonding skills, you return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
faq.q: Do you keep the Gray Forest Wolf as a permanent companion?

sections.body: Josephine Carson watches as you take another step in learning to handle beasts. You have practiced with simple boars; now you enter the forest to tame a Gray Forest Wolf. The enchanted rod she gives you helps calm the predator. Patience and respect matter as much as tracking and marksmanship when you seek a wild creature's trust.
sections.title: The Path of the Hunter

sections.body: Josephine Carson gives you a specialized Taming Rod to calm dangerous wildlife. Approach the wolf with patience and precision, and overcome its aggression without lethal force. After practicing your bond with the beast, return the rod to Josephine as proof of your growing skill.
sections.title: A Test of Instinct and Trust

summary: Josephine Carson guides you through Taming the Beast as you learn to handle a boar before facing a Gray Forest Wolf. With a Taming Rod, you seek the fiercer creature's trust.
attribution: In-game quest text: Taming the Beast
